summary: Nine NBA Cup group games were played on Wednesday. Victor Wembanyama scored a night-high 44 points in San Antonio's 116-111 loss at Portland, and LeBron James had 25 points, 10 rebounds and 12 assists in Philadelphia's 111-104 win over Miami. Chicago edged Charlotte 107-105 in the night's closest game, and Golden State scored 44 first-quarter points in a 129-110 win over Sacramento.

games.headline: LeBron James triple-double lifts 76ers past Heat
games.story: Miami led by as many as eight in the first quarter, but Philadelphia went ahead for good at 39-38 early in the second and stretched the lead to 16 in the third. The Heat scored the last nine points of the game to make the final margin seven. LeBron James had 25 points, 10 rebounds and 12 assists, Tyrese Maxey scored 30 and VJ Edgecombe added 18. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 32 points and 14 rebounds for Miami, and Philadelphia was without Joel Embiid.

games.headline: Bulls hold off Hornets despite Brandon Miller's 35
games.story: The lead changed hands 22 times, and Chicago went ahead for good at 98-97 on a Nic Claxton dunk with 2:30 left. Matas Buzelis scored 24 points, including a tip-in and two free throws in the final 23 seconds, and Josh Giddey had 12 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists. Brandon Miller scored 35 for Charlotte and Moussa Diabaté had 14 points and 14 rebounds. The Hornets were without Kon Knueppel and Grayson Allen.

games.headline: Knicks pull away from Cavaliers with 39-point fourth
games.story: Cleveland led 61-56 at halftime and 85-77 late in the third quarter before New York scored 17 straight points, going ahead for good at 87-85 early in the fourth. The Knicks outscored the Cavaliers 39-17 in the fourth quarter and won by 19, their largest lead. Jose Alvarado scored 21 points on 8-of-10 shooting off the bench, and Josh Hart had 15 points and 11 assists. Donovan Mitchell scored 30 and James Harden 28 for Cleveland, which was without Evan Mobley, while OG Anunoby did not play for New York.

games.headline: Jaden McDaniels scores 32 as Wolves top Thunder
games.story: Oklahoma City outscored Minnesota 37-21 in the second quarter and led by 11 midway through the third before the Timberwolves finished that quarter with 40 points. Minnesota went ahead for good at 84-82 with 14 seconds left in the third and held on in the fourth. Jaden McDaniels scored 32 points on 11-of-15 shooting with 10 rebounds, and LaMelo Ball added 19 points and eight assists. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 32 for the Thunder, who were without Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams, while Minnesota played without Anthony Edwards.

games.headline: Grizzlies lead wire to wire against Clippers
games.story: Memphis scored first and never trailed, outscoring Los Angeles 32-15 in the first quarter. The Grizzlies led by as many as 22 in the fourth quarter. Jaylen Wells scored 19 points, Cam Spencer added 16, and Ty Jerome had 17 points, seven assists and four steals. Brandon Ingram led the Clippers with 18 points, and Los Angeles made 6 of 30 three-point attempts while playing without Bradley Beal.

games.headline: Julius Randle scores 28 as Nets beat Bucks
games.story: Milwaukee led 9-2 early, but Brooklyn scored 13 straight points later in the first quarter to go up 18-11. The lead changed hands seven times before the Nets went ahead for good at 68-67 late in the third, and they led by as many as 14 in the fourth. Julius Randle scored 28 points with nine rebounds, and Day'Ron Sharpe had 11 points, 14 rebounds and four steals. Tyler Herro scored 28 and Jaime Jaquez Jr. 21 for the Bucks.

games.headline: Alperen Sengun's triple-double carries Rockets past Suns
games.story: Phoenix led by seven early in the second quarter, but Houston went ahead for good at 50-49 later in the period and led 66-56 at halftime. The Rockets stretched the lead to 14 in the third quarter. Alperen Sengun had 23 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists, Kevin Durant scored 20 with 10 rebounds and Amen Thompson added 18 points and 10 rebounds. Devin Booker scored 25 for the Suns, who made 5 of 32 three-point attempts.

games.headline: Warriors score 44 in first quarter, roll past Kings
games.story: Golden State outscored Sacramento 44-19 in the first quarter, helped by a 15-0 run, and led by 29 early in the second. The Kings scored 36 in the third quarter and got within 82-78, but the Warriors led 101-89 after three. De'Anthony Melton scored 24 points with eight threes and Gui Santos added 22 as Golden State made 20 threes without Stephen Curry and Jimmy Butler III. Domantas Sabonis had 27 points and 10 rebounds on 8-of-9 shooting for Sacramento.

games.headline: Avdija, Lillard outlast Wembanyama's 44 in Portland
games.story: The lead changed hands 25 times and the teams were tied 13 times, the last at 109-109 with two minutes left. Portland then scored the next five points and held on. Deni Avdija had 33 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists, and Damian Lillard scored 29, making all 10 of his free throws, as the Trail Blazers made 19 threes. Victor Wembanyama scored 44 points with 16 rebounds for San Antonio, which was without De'Aaron Fox and Dylan Harper.
